notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
easyPrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying its mana cost.
When Dockside Extortionist enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each artifact and/or enchantment your opponents control.
Activate Plate Armor by paying {0}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Cowardice triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
